test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options.

It is a well - known fact / that the Monarchy is / not the best form / of governance.
solution:
The part that contains the error is option 1 i.e. that the Monarchy is.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error lies in the incorrect use of the article "**the**" before "**Monarchy**."
 
• The word "**Monarchy**" should not be preceded by "the" when it is used in a general sense.
 
• The correct sentence should be, "It is a well-known fact that Monarchy is not the best form of governance."
 
• The other parts of the sentence are grammatically correct.

Hence, the error is in option 1.
